senses.gloss:
mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Who or what kills kine.
m. (-घ्नः)
A guest.
E.
गो a cow, and घ्न what kills, from हन् with टक् affix; a cow being killed on the arrival of the latter, or being presented to him.

n. (-तं)
1 Rain.
2 Ghee made from cow's milk.
E.
गो the earth, घृत what sprinkles, from घृ to sprinkle or wet, affix क्त.
